_spec: SNG-648 §4 — Silas Weir's nemesis, chosen by hand against the rules above so the engine's choice can be checked against it. Applied to char-mrhs8286 by a reconcile step when nemesis.js lands; never hand-edited into the save.

why.text: He is a Wright who finished something and was nearly exiled for it; she is the Wrights' pure pole, making that cannot stop to ask whether it should. Each is the other's idea of the fatal mistake.
The Ceaseless want ground to build on and build over what is not given. Silas holds five places, and the Made Gate is a finished making.
She is the Building challenger; the Last Mercy holds the seat. If she climbs past her, she stops being a rival and becomes a Sovereign.
His arc: 'what completion costs.' Hers: completion is death.

nemesis.status: wounded by the Deep Lantern, dormant since world day 68 — resting, not beaten

legendTie.relation: the legend surfaces into the nemesis's hands
legendTie.gmLine: The Finished Thing is loose in the substrate — half-made in his image and half-made in nothing's. It is the one thing in the world a Wright can build onto forever. When it surfaces, it surfaces where the Ceaseless are building.

shortlist.text: His mother is in Cairnhold, Stillwater's Trouble stands on Palelands ground, and his spear keeps a death register. Morvane is free again (Neth's stop ran out day 49).
Marrow — Maren Ossitide, who knows and hunts the Hollow King — is his companion at bond 10. At stage 3 a Sovereign goes after its opponents, and Silas stands closest to her.
